title: An Introduction to the $p$-Differential Forms in Spinor Variables on the Minkowskian Manifold
summary: This article presents an introductory study of $p$-differential forms in spinor variables defined on the Minkowskian (or Lorentzian) manifold. Starting from the algebraic and geometric foundations of spinor spaces and Clifford algebras, we establish the correspondence between Minkowski spacetime and Hermitian matrices in spinor coordinates. Within this framework, we construct differential 1-forms and 2-forms expressed in spinor notation, and formulate the Dirac operator in terms of exterior calculus.
